integrity: General spectral resolvent and two-species protein/output NFB PSD criteria are acknowledged as prior art; no independent mathematical or priority review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary Gaussian linear-noise limit only; not a finite-size chemical-master-equation PSD. Exact cubic thresholds are normalized-rate-specific; nearby rates retain a three-phase witness but need not retain the same threshold count.
title: Reentrant mRNA spectral resonance with purely real relaxation modes in a two-stage feedback circuit
